mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp:115-120: MODEL_BODY_HELM + i and its fellows load HelmClass{i+1}, ArmorClass{i+1} and the rest, and a character with no armour wears MODEL_BODY_* + SkinIndex (ZzzCharacter.cpp:12124-12346), numbered one over MU's zero-based classes -- so Class04 is the Magic Gladiator, class 3.
part_note: The head, its red hair and the high collar. 158 triangles. 37 vertices are bound to Bip01 Spine1 -- the hair and collar on the nape and shoulders, 1.54 to 1.70 m -- and 73 to Bip01 Head; MU's binding is kept, as it is the hair resting on his back (the Dark Knight's head is repaired because his seam was a ring at the neck, HelmClass02.json's rebind).
sheet_from: Data/Player/skin_special_01.OZJ (256x256), from MuMain. All five parts name this one sheet: the red hair, the face, and the navy outfit with its gold trim and the sun on the chest.
cull_from: As HelmClass02: MU's hair is flat single-sided fins, and culled they wink out as the head turns (HelmClass02.json's cull_note).
material_note: Read off the sheet (the islands' mu_uv count V from its foot): 0 is the face, top right -- skin; 1 the red hair strip along the bottom -- hair; 2 the navy collar piece in the bottom right corner -- cloth.
